application_time_invisible_policy.scope_observation: The Greenhouse application footer links to this general Invisible privacy policy; this locator does not prove every listing or later contractor task uses only this policy.

retention_observations.general_rule: Personal information is retained for as long as the Services are used or as necessary for the stated purposes, disputes, defenses, audits, legitimate business purposes, agreements, and applicable law.

contractor_time_meridial_policy.scope_observation: The page states that it applies to contractors who access or use Meridial contributor services; it is not treated as a substitute for the application-time policy or any client-specific policy.
observed_categories: The policy describes collection of account, residence, education, employment, reference, CV, taxpayer, government-ID, payment, communication, project, and task information.
Identity verification may include selfies, government-ID images, video or audio, and facial measurements that may be biometric or sensitive data.
Task monitoring may include full-screen recording, facial geometry, eye tracking, and presence detection when indicated.
Information shared with clients can include contact details, qualifications, work product, screen recordings, and biometric monitoring data where required by a client agreement.
Client-specific tools and privacy practices may be controlled separately by the client.

retention_observations.integrity_and_identity_verification_reco: Up to three years following the last interaction with the Services, or as necessary to comply with legal obligations.
retention_observations.security_exception: Data associated with account bans, investigations into fraudulent or non-compliant activities, or security incidents may be retained indefinitely.
retention_observations.screen_recording_retention: Fourteen days following Task completion; recordings may be retained longer if relevant to an ongoing investigation, dispute, or legal matter.
retention_observations.biometric_monitoring_retention: Fourteen (14) days following Task completion; it may be retained longer for an ongoing investigation into fraudulent or non-compliant activities, but in no event longer than one (1) year after the purpose for collection has been satisfied.

privacy_policy_chain.decision_effect: Before any application, identity verification, assessment, account creation, or contractor acceptance, preserve a durable raw artifact or full screenshot with requested URL, final URL, content hash, and fresh independent replay; then obtain user review and exact authorization for the policy, terms, requested personal-data fields, monitoring scope, client identity, work authorization, tax, payment, retention, and deletion consequences.

observed_mix: Some self-reported applicants describe spending multiple hours on assessments, unclear scoring, stalled verification, weak support, or no project assignment.
Some self-reported contractors describe paid training time, successful payment, and useful projects, while other comments describe patchy project availability or rates below alternatives.

A BBB complaint describes a fraudulent-check and equipment-purchase recruitment scam using the company name; that report does not prove the official Greenhouse or Meridial process caused it and may reflect impersonation.
non_authoritative_experience_counterevid.evidence_limit: These reports are anecdotal, self-selected, and not independently verified. They establish plausible failure modes, not their frequency and not a verdict that the official opportunity is legitimate or illegitimate.
non_authoritative_experience_counterevid.decision_effect: Any future packet must use only official domains, prohibit checks, equipment purchases, deposits, fees, or off-platform payment, predefine an unpaid-assessment time cap, and require exact contract and payment terms before work begins.

cross_lead_inference.claim: The locator pages show five public listings that request evaluation or QA work and one separate talent-network page. Only three listings state present cash compensation; the equity-only, compensation-unstated, and talent-network records are excluded from current cash-flow candidates. None is durable Gate evidence, and none establishes that this user will be selected, paid at any particular rate, assigned hours, or permitted to work under the relevant terms.
cross_lead_inference.portfolio_implication: A small content-addressed local evaluation artifact can be assessed as portfolio evidence against explicit job requirements, but passing it is neither demand validation nor application authorization.
